# DCC-MCP

> DCC-MCP provides a Gateway, typed CLI, MCP and REST endpoints, adapters, and Skills for creative applications.

Languages: [English](https://dcc-mcp.github.io/llms.txt) · [简体中文](https://dcc-mcp.github.io/zh/llms.txt)

## Canonical entry points

- [Homepage and setup prompt](https://dcc-mcp.github.io/)
- [Why DCC-MCP exists](https://dcc-mcp.github.io/why-dcc-mcp): The production problems, lessons, technical boundaries, and deliberate limits behind the architecture.
- [Marketplace search](https://dcc-mcp.github.io/marketplace): Search the official catalog and copy a setup prompt or typed CLI installation command.
- [Showcase gallery](https://dcc-mcp.github.io/showcase): View outputs, owning repositories, validation notes, and prompts.
- [Wwise audio showcase](https://dcc-mcp.github.io/showcase/wwise): Play deterministic sound effects and background music validated through typed WAAPI tools.
- [AI + DCC control guides](https://dcc-mcp.github.io/use-cases): Direct answers and copyable prompts for every public creative-application and pipeline integration.
- [Agent workflow](https://dcc-mcp.github.io/agents): Install the public Skill, discover typed tools, validate calls, and diagnose failures.
- [Developer guide](https://dcc-mcp.github.io/developers): Local examples and validation steps for a private standalone MCP service, DCC adapter, or specialized Skill.
- [Ecosystem directory](https://dcc-mcp.github.io/ecosystem): Adapters, extensions, asset providers, generation services, and studio integrations.
- [Core documentation](https://dcc-mcp.github.io/dcc-mcp-core/): Gateway, CLI, MCP/REST, security, observability, and Python API.

## Agent Skills

- [Canonical distribution repository](https://github.com/dcc-mcp/dcc-mcp-agent-plugins): One Skill source with universal and native installation paths.
- [dcc-mcp](https://clawhub.ai/loonghao/skills/dcc-mcp): Operate live DCCs and install official Marketplace extensions.
- [dcc-mcp-creator](https://clawhub.ai/loonghao/skills/dcc-mcp-creator): Create or modernize a DCC adapter/runtime or a private non-DCC standalone MCP service without requiring GitHub.
- [dcc-mcp-skills-creator](https://clawhub.ai/loonghao/skills/dcc-mcp-skills-creator): Create, validate, or improve a DCC-specific Skill package.

Universal install: `npx --yes skills@1.5.22 add dcc-mcp/dcc-mcp-agent-plugins --skill dcc-mcp`

## Current released integrations

`dcc-mcp-cli dcc-types` currently exposes 24 adapter-backed identifiers: `3dsmax`, `aftereffects`, `blender`, `c4d`, `freecad`, `godot`, `houdini`, `katana`, `mari`, `maya`, `marmoset`, `mobu`, `nuke`, `openscad`, `openusd`, `photoshop`, `premiere`, `renderdoc`, `shotgrid`, `substance3d_designer`, `substance3d_painter`, `unity`, `unreal`, and `zbrush`. Custom studio host identifiers are also supported.

## Marketplace CLI contract

```text
dcc-mcp-cli marketplace search --query "rigging"
dcc-mcp-cli marketplace install <package-name> --dcc <dcc-type> --reload
```

Inspect unfamiliar packages before installation. When the exact ID is known,
install it directly with `--reload`; always obtain user consent before changing local state.

## Failure and bug-report contract

Preserve the failed call's `request_id`. Run `dcc-mcp-cli doctor`, inspect failure-filtered `dcc-mcp-cli stats`, then discover and use `dcc_feedback__report`. Review public-safe evidence before sharing it, and never create an external issue without explicit user authorization.
